headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with José Ramírez leading the charge at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run (8) on a fly ball to left field and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. James McCann, the catcher for the Arizona Diamondbacks, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained right quad. Additionally, Joe Mantiply of the Toronto Blue Jays has been placed on the 15-day injured list with left knee inflammation.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a notable trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Chicago White Sox also made a trade, acquiring center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles in a lopsided 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Suffer Shutout Loss to Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves fell to the Miami Marlins 12-0 in a one-sided matchup. Javier Sanoja led the Braves' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks C James McCann Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks catcher James McCann has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained right quad.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash on May 17, 2026.
